    Prepare CellTFusion folds for cross-validation with training and test data

    prepare_CellTFusion_folds.Rd

    This function prepares data for k-fold cross-validation using the CellTFusion framework. It supports two modes of operation:

    1. If a set of tuned hyperparameters is provided via bestune, the function will process the full dataset once with those parameters and return a single processed training set.

    2. If no tuned parameters are provided, the function will construct fold-specific training and test datasets, expanding over a grid of CellTFusion hyperparameters and returning them for subsequent model training and hyperparameter selection.

    prepare_CellTFusion_folds(
  data,
  folds = NULL,
  deconv = NULL,
  universe = NULL,
  paths = NULL,
  normalized = FALSE,
  coldata,
  trait,
  trait.positive,
  ncores = NULL,
  min_targets_size,
  minMod,
  corr_mod,
  corr,
  high_corr_groups,
  bestune = NULL
)

    Arguments

    data

    A data frame containing gene expression data (samples x genes) and a column named target indicating class labels.

    folds

    A list of integer vectors indicating row indices for the training set in each fold. The test set is implicitly defined as the complement.

    deconv

    A matrix or data frame of deconvolution features (samples x features). If NULL, CellTFusion will run without these features.

    universe

    Optional universe of features for CellTFusion.

    paths

    Optional list of prior knowledge resources for CellTFusion.

    normalized

    Logical. Whether the gene expression data is already normalized. Defaults to FALSE.

    coldata

    A data frame with metadata (e.g., sample annotations), must match the number and order of samples in data.

    trait

    A character string specifying the name of the column in coldata containing the trait of interest (e.g., response).

    trait.positive

    A character string indicating the positive class label for the trait.

    ncores

    Integer. Number of CPU cores to use for parallelization. If NULL, parallel::detectCores() - 2 is used.

    min_targets_size

    Hyperparameters for CellTFusion

    minMod

    Hyperparameters for CellTFusion

    corr_mod

    Hyperparameters for CellTFusion

    corr

    Hyperparameters for CellTFusion

    high_corr_groups

    Hyperparameters for CellTFusion. These can be provided as vectors to define a tuning grid when bestune = NULL.

    bestune

    Optional. A data frame of tuned hyperparameters. If provided, the function skips fold construction and directly processes the full dataset using these values.

    Value

    A list with two possible structures depending on bestune:

    • If bestune is provided:

      • train_cell_data_final: Final processed cell group feature matrix for the full dataset, including the target column.

      • custom_output: The full CellTFusion object from training.

      • best_celltfusion_params: The tuned hyperparameters used.

    • If bestune is NULL:

      • processed_folds: A list of folds. Each fold contains:

        • train_data: Processed training data with cell group features and target.

        • test_data: Projected test data in the learned feature space.

        • obs_test: True class labels for the test set.

        • rowIndex: Row indices corresponding to the test samples.

        • fold_name: Fold identifier (if provided).

        • params: Hyperparameter values used for this fold.

    Details

    For each fold, training and test sets are generated by running the CellTFusion() pipeline on the training data (gene expression and optional deconvolution features). The trained projection is then applied to the test data to ensure comparability between folds.

    When bestune = NULL, the function expands all possible hyperparameter combinations via expand.grid() and runs CellTFusion separately for each fold and parameter set. This can be computationally expensive, so the function supports parallelization via foreach, doParallel, and parallel.

    The results of this function are designed to be passed directly to compute_custom_k_fold_CV() for hyperparameter selection and model evaluation.
